column1: # Omarchy-style global shortcuts for KDE Plasma 6.
#   keys:  KDE key names, several separated by " | "; the list REPLACES the action's keys
#   kind:  kwin / plasmashell / ksmserver  -> built-in action (target = action id)
#          app  -> launch an installed .desktop file (target = desktop file name)
#          cmd  -> run a command (a hidden koma-*.desktop launcher is generated)
#          koma -> kOMA Launcher menu or action (target = menu id/alias)
# Any other action already holding one of these keys loses that key.

column4: Activate launcher (Super alone no longer opens it)
